import unreal
target='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest'
rt=unreal.load_asset('/Game/SSPR_Validation/RT_SSPR_Occupancy')
preview=next((c for c in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraComponent) if c.get_asset() and c.get_asset().get_path_name()==target and c.get_owner() is None),None)
if preview is None or rt is None: raise RuntimeError('Preview or RT missing')
preview.set_variable_texture_render_target('User.OccupancyRTParam',rt)
preview.set_force_solo(True)
preview.set_component_tick_enabled(True)
preview.reinitialize_system()
preview.activate(True)
preview.advance_simulation(180,1.0/60.0)
unreal.RenderingLibrary.export_render_target(preview,rt,unreal.Paths.project_saved_dir(),'SSPR_RT_Preview_LiveA')
print('LIVE_A='+preview.get_path_name())
